title: wattprint configuration
description: Configuration for wattprint carbon estimation, budgets, and CI checks. All emission figures produced from this config are modeled estimates, not measurements.

configVersion.description: Config format version. Carried into every result object for reproducibility.

model.description: Estimation model id. Built-in: swdm-v4 (Sustainable Web Design Model v4).

traffic.description: Traffic assumptions used to weight routes and annualize totals.

pageviewsPerMonth.description: Total pageviews per month across all routes. Used for annualized figures, which are traffic-dependent.

routeWeights.description: Relative traffic share per route path (normalized internally). Routes not listed share the remainder equally.

returningVisitorRatio.description: Fraction of pageviews served to returning visitors, modeled with warm-cache transfer sizes when available.

audienceGridIntensity.description: Grid intensity of the audience's electricity, in g CO2e/kWh. A single number, or a geo-weighted table whose shares should sum to 1. Omit to use the model's global default.

hostingProvider.description: Free-text provider name, recorded in results for auditability.

hostingGridIntensity.description: Grid intensity of hosting electricity in g CO2e/kWh. Ignored when greenHostingVerified is true.

greenHostingVerified.description: Set only when the host's green-energy claim is externally verified (e.g. Green Web Foundation dataset). Zeroes the datacenter operational-electricity segment; embodied emissions still count.

cdnCacheHitRatio.description: Fraction of requests served from CDN edge cache rather than origin.

budgets.description: Carbon and transfer budgets checked by `wattprint budget` and CI.

maxGramsPerPageview.description: Maximum modeled g CO2e per pageview (site-weighted average).

maxTransferKbPerPageview.description: Maximum first-visit wire transfer per pageview, in KB (1000 bytes).

perRoute.description: Per-route overrides of the two budget limits.

failCiOnBreach.description: When true, `wattprint budget` exits nonzero on any breach.

measure.description: Measurement settings for deterministic CI runs.

runs.description: Measurement repetitions per route; the median run is reported.
